description: Clipboard write capability — outbound only (write-text). Chunk #43 snapshot copy-to-clipboard surface. Per security plan §Logging clipboard hygiene the clipboard-write step emits a non-suppressible 'X bytes copied' visible signal via pulse://stream/snapshot-progress event. NEVER add clipboard-manager:allow-read-text or allow-read-image — clipboard read would let the webview exfiltrate user clipboard contents (separate threat surface; would need its own capability with stated rationale).
